items.name: Total backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: As of June 30, 2026, MYR's backlog was $3.16 billion, an increase of $518.4 million, or 19.6 percent, from $2.64 billion a year earlier.
items.source_excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, MYR's backlog was $3.16 billion, which was an increase of $518.4 million, or 19.6 percent, from the $2.64 billion reported as of June 30, 2025.

items.name: T&D and C&I segment backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: MYR's June 30, 2026 backlog split by segment: Transmission & Distribution (T&D) at $1.27 billion, Commercial & Industrial (C&I) at $1.89 billion.
items.source_excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, T&D backlog was $1.27 billion and C&I backlog was $1.89 billion.

notes: Backlog is MYR Group's own leading indicator of contracted transmission and distribution (T&D) and commercial and industrial (C&I) construction work; no discrete named contract, product, or project disclosures were found in the stored Q2 2026 earnings release (data/edgar/docs/MYRG.json). No remaining-performance-obligation field exists in data/market/MYRG.json.fundamentals.
